title: Ashgrove CareAssure Care Setting Shares and Annual Day Limits
content:
# Care setting shares of the monthly maximum

Asset-Based Long-Term Care Life Insurance pays, for each care setting, up to a share of the policy's monthly maximum benefit. This table gives, for every Ashgrove CareAssure tier, the share applicable to formal home care, to care by an informal caregiver who is not a family member living with the insured, and to care received outside the United States, together with the lifetime limit on months of international benefits and the calendar-year day limits for bed reservation and respite care.

| Tier | Formal home care | Informal caregiver | Care outside the United States | Lifetime limit on months of international benefits | Bed reservation days per calendar year | Respite care days per calendar year |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ashgrove CareAssure 2-Year | 1.00 | 0.50 | 0.50 | 24 | 30 | 21 |
| Ashgrove CareAssure 3-Year | 1.00 | 0.50 | 0.50 | 24 | 30 | 21 |
| Ashgrove CareAssure 4-Year | 1.00 | 0.50 | 0.50 | 24 | 30 | 21 |
| Ashgrove CareAssure 5-Year | 1.00 | 0.50 | 0.50 | 24 | 30 | 21 |
| Ashgrove CareAssure 6-Year | 1.00 | 0.50 | 0.50 | 24 | 30 | 21 |
| Ashgrove CareAssure Lifetime | 1.00 | 0.50 | 0.50 | 24 | 30 | 21 |

## Definitions used in the table

- **Formal home care share** — the share of the monthly maximum payable for formal home care: 1.00, that is 100 percent.
- **Informal caregiver share** — the share payable for care by an informal caregiver who is not a family member living with the insured: 0.50, that is 50 percent.
- **International share** — the share payable for care received outside the United States: 0.50, that is 50 percent, for no more than 24 months in the insured's lifetime.
- **Bed reservation** — the days per calendar year a facility bed is paid while the insured is hospitalized: 30.
- **Respite care** — the days per calendar year of respite care paid at the facility rate: 21.

## Illustration (hypothetical monthly maximum)

| Hypothetical monthly maximum | Formal home care | Informal caregiver | Outside the United States |
|---|---|---|---|
| $5000.00 | up to $5000.00 | up to $2500.00 | up to $2500.00 |
| $4166.67 | up to $4166.67 | up to $2083.34 | up to $2083.34 |

Each figure is the monthly maximum multiplied by the setting's share and rounded to the cent ($4166.67 multiplied by 0.50 is $2083.335, rounded to $2083.34).
